# Jewel Isaac, LLC

> Jewel Isaac, LLC is an Alaska general contractor headquartered in Fairbanks with an Anchorage office, self-performing commercial, government and defense, industrial, mining, and oil & gas construction across the state. Founded in 2016; licensed, bonded, insured, and SAM.gov-registered.

Jewel Isaac builds in some of the harshest conditions in North America — remote, cold-climate, and logistically complex sites across Alaska. Work includes design-build and general contracting, tenant improvements and facility renovations (including federal and defense), workforce housing and man camps, site utilities, and self-perform trades. Heavy civil and specialty scopes are subcontracted and coordinated under Jewel Isaac's management.

## Key facts
- Company: Jewel Isaac, LLC (Alaska general contractor)
- Founded: 2016 — Managing Member: Seth Church
- Headquarters: 300 Barnette St, Suite 202, Fairbanks, AK 99701
- Anchorage office: 1352 W 31st Ave, Anchorage, AK 99503
- Phone: (907) 415-1600
- Email: estimating@jewelisaac.com (bids) · careers@jewelisaac.com (jobs)
- Service area: State of Alaska — Fairbanks, Anchorage, the North Slope, and remote/village sites
- Markets: Commercial, Government & Defense, Industrial, Mining, Oil & Gas
- Credentials: Alaska General Contractor License #115766, UEI ULLZLBKHGCB8, CAGE 7PYR4, NAICS 236220, SAM.gov registered, bonded and insured
- Safety: zero-harm culture, EMR 0.71
